metadata.description: Scholar Method: a scholar-led research companion for inquiry, evidence, thinking, writing and continuity.

plugins.name: scholar
plugins.description: Everything in one install: Scholar Core, Research, Writing and Publish.

plugins.name: scholar-core
plugins.description: How we work with a scholar: start or adopt a research project without overwriting it, the scholar contract (evidence integrity, approvals, conversation posture), catch-up and check-out, harvest and forge.

plugins.name: scholar-research
plugins.description: Thinking and evidence: reflect on loose ideas, find and read secondary sources, map claims to questions, analyse supplied data and draw evidence-linked visuals.

plugins.name: scholar-writing
plugins.description: Author-directed writing support: evidence-gated drafting, voice review with a prose linter and fact guard, and citation checks.

plugins.name: scholar-publish
plugins.description: From manuscript to submission: a build with preflight checks and a pre-submission checklist for a journal, conference or university.
